item.title: New Mexico Goatheads Surpass 1K Season Ticket Deposits
item.description: SPORTS News: RIO RANCHO — The New Mexico Goatheads hockey team announced that the organization has surpassed 1,000 season ticket deposits for the team’s inaugural 2026–27 ECHL season at the Rio Rancho Events Center. This milestone marks a significant step in the franchise’s launch and underscores the strong statewide enthusiasm for the return of professional hockey. item.title: New Mexico PED To Offer 3,000 Paid High School Internships
item.description: Public Education Secretary Mariana D.
